items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: They called him in, and Lawson fell out with the man that owned the dance hall, which was upstairs.

ctx.x: Yeah. They called him in, and Lawson fell out with the man that owned the dance hall, which was upstairs. Somewhere on Central Avenue, it was up above a cafe. I've forgotten, the name will come to me. But, anyway, so then they sent for the piano player, singer, that died? Nat Cole.
